title: Run of the borrow computation
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $p$ be an allowed input-head position, and let $u$ and $v$ be finite Boolean words. Starting the one-tape debit machine in its initial search state, with its head at position $|v|$ and its tape containing the concatenation $v u$, after $b+1$ steps it is in the borrow-result state carrying the Boolean outcome of the borrow operation on $u$, its head is at position $|v|+b-1$, and its tape contains $v$ followed by the resulting word, where $b$ is the length of the initial segment of $u$ consisting of false entries.
